purpose: Honest headline latency for bb_patterns scope=all on the current corpus, measured on a QUIET box (the M57 receipt recorded numbers under machine load ~15 from co-agent builds; this re-measure resolves that disclosed caveat).
dist: rebuilt at HEAD before measuring (npx tsup, build success)

method.engine: script/m57/probe-scope-all.ts --mode src (direct engine import, N rounds)
method.mcpCold: script/m57/probe-scope-all.ts --dist (fresh `node bin/bb mcp` per round: includes Node boot + MCP handshake)
method.mcpWarm: script/m57/probe-scope-all-warm.ts (ONE long-lived server, initialize once, N sequential request→response round-trips per tool — what an agent actually experiences)

headline.bb_patterns_scope_all_warmPerCall: 1465–2618 ms (p50 1655 ms at load ~5; p50 2618 ms at load ~9)
headline.bb_patterns_scope_all_coldCli: ~3000–3490 ms end-to-end (includes Node boot + MCP handshake)

caveats: First call in a fresh MCP server is slower than steady state (lazy engine/analyzer initialization): 4568 ms in runB, 20694 ms in runA under load ~9 (opencode + client-tooling at ~100% CPU). Steady state is the number shown above; the first-call penalty is disclosed, not hidden.
The box is shared with co-agent processes; load average is recorded per run so every number is attributable.
Cold-process numbers include Node startup (~1.5–2.5 s) that a long-lived MCP client never pays per call.

Parity of the findings payload across modes was proven by M57's T3 gate (17/17 on both runtimes); the digests here are recorded for traceability and intentionally differ by mode because the MCP result envelope differs from the engine's raw payload.

before.note: M50 receipt recorded scope=all at 1345 ms on the smaller pre-M57 corpus (2867 files) and >90 s (hard timeout) before M50's bounding work.
